property_summary: For any access-control address, once C's initialize has completed, the initializer latch must be advanced so a second initialize reverts with InvalidInitialization; the mutant never sets _initialized=1, so a second initialize succeeds, violating the one-shot rule.
change_summary: Remove `$._initialized = 1;` so the initialized version never advances past 0, allowing initialize(...) to be called repeatedly instead of reverting with InvalidInitialization on the second call.
